entry.title: Manual reporting still common among smaller firms
entry.content:
Finance teams at smaller Malaysian firms continue to rely on manual reporting, according to a survey published this week. Respondents described consolidating figures from several systems by hand each month because the tools they use do not integrate with one another.

Roughly half said they have no visibility into monthly margins until the accounts close, a delay that leaves pricing decisions running on stale numbers. Others pointed to a data silo between point-of-sale and accounting as the root cause, and said the manual workaround has become permanent.

The survey covered 400 firms across the Klang Valley, Penang and Johor over a six-week window earlier this year.
